name: Highly Skilled Immigrant Visa (N4A)

requirements.blocker_text: Specialized knowledge or technical expertise in an area relevant to Nigeria's economic needs.
Letter of recommendation from Nigeria's Industrial Training Fund (ITF) Skills Gap Assessment confirming the expertise addresses a genuine domestic skills gap.

evidence_required.document: ITF Skills Gap Assessment recommendation letter

outcome.duration_length: initial 90 days, then a 5-year renewable multiple-entry residence permit

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS) -- Highly Skilled Immigrant Visa N4A: for foreign nationals with specialized knowledge/technical expertise relevant to Nigeria's economic needs, requires ITF (Industrial Training Fund) Skills Gap Assessment recommendation letter; holders permitted to work and reside in Nigeria; initial 90 days then 5-year renewable multiple-entry residence permit; extendable

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Nigeria). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 NIS sourced. Modeled as 'work_independent' rather than 'work_sponsored' since NIS's own page describes holders as 'permitted to work and reside in Nigeria' without tying the grant to a single sponsoring employer the way ng_work_permit.json's Expatriate Quota mechanism does -- this reads as a skills-based national-interest route rather than an employer-petition route, though the distinction is not stated in NIS's own terms as explicitly as this dataset's schema requires, so treat the category assignment as an interpretation rather than a directly-sourced fact. It sits under NIS's Permanent Residence Visa (PRV) grouping (code N4A) alongside investor and spousal PR categories -- see ng_investor_residence.json and ng_family_reunification.json for the others. citizenship_after_months cross-referenced from ng_citizenship_naturalisation.json, not independently sourced here.
